For 0<t<1 the cone X>=Z>=0 is invariant, the strictly positive Perron coefficient rules out cancellation, and sum_{m>=0}r^-m S^m converges iff r>lambda_+(t). Exact Laplace tail likelihood ratios attain finite-prefix suprema; monotone cylinder extension yields the full transcript bound, while divergence of prefix losses refutes every finite epsilon. t>=1 gives nondecaying/growing primal shifts. The exact resolvent returns epsilon=delta*(step*r*(r+1-t)/dx+r²*(1-t)/dy)/(r²-r*t²+t²-t). Independent symbolic characteristic polynomial and resolvent checks reproduce the h=1, step=1/2, r=4/5, dx=dy=delta=1 certificate 84/19. No convergence claim for optimization iterates.
